title: Second Meeting Delbert

nodes.speaker: Delbert Cherry
nodes.text: Back to ease your soco, Cosmo?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Back to ease your soco, Cosmo?

nodes.speaker: Delbert Cherry
nodes.text: Your social conscience. Here to visit us Rigowners, share your steam-filled dreams?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Your social conscience. Here to visit us Rigowners, share your steam-filled dreams?

nodes.speaker: Delbert Cherry
nodes.text: Well, open up your knowledge box, cos here it comes. The Corps might control the water, but we are oil, and O.R.S is the spark that will ignite the inferno of freedom.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Well, open up your knowledge box, cos here it comes. The Corps might control the water, but we are oil, and O.R.S is the spark that will ignite the inferno of freedom.

nodes.speaker: Delbert Cherry
nodes.text: We're planning an intervention. CEOs want to blow this place, send us down to the bottom of the ocean. But we won't go without a fight.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: We're planning an intervention. CEOs want to blow this place, send us down to the bottom of the ocean. But we won't go without a fight.

nodes.speaker: Delbert Cherry
nodes.text: If you wanna know more, you have to become a member. So are you in, or are you all the way out?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: If you wanna know more, you have to become a member. So are you in, or are you all the way out?

nodes.speaker: Delbert Cherry
nodes.text: Too bad, Cosmo. Coulda used someone like you.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Too bad, Cosmo. Coulda used someone like you.

nodes.speaker: Delbert Cherry
nodes.text: No loss. Enjoy the view from the Spire, Cosmo.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: No loss. Enjoy the view from the Spire, Cosmo.

nodes.speaker: Delbert Cherry
nodes.text: Alright. But if you're serious, you gotta prove it.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Alright. But if you're serious, you gotta prove it.

nodes.speaker: Delbert Cherry
nodes.text: I only share my poetry with people I trust. You want me to trust you? Prove it.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I only share my poetry with people I trust. You want me to trust you? Prove it.

nodes.speaker: Delbert Cherry
nodes.text: Fulfil the three rules of O.R.S. First rule: every new member must recruit at least two further members.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Fulfil the three rules of O.R.S. First rule: every new member must recruit at least two further members.

nodes.speaker: Delbert Cherry
nodes.text: It's a hard core. Like a dinosaur crushing oil into diamonds.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: It's a hard core. Like a dinosaur crushing oil into diamonds.

nodes.speaker: Delbert Cherry
nodes.text: The second rule of O.R.S: all members must contribute a line of verse to Pipeline, our weekly zine.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: The second rule of O.R.S: all members must contribute a line of verse to Pipeline, our weekly zine.

nodes.speaker: Delbert Cherry
nodes.text: All members must participate in activities to further the O.R.S. cause.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: All members must participate in activities to further the O.R.S. cause.

nodes.speaker: Delbert Cherry
nodes.text: There's a list of candidates. But be careful. Some might be corpsters. Underground agents.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: There's a list of candidates. But be careful. Some might be corpsters. Underground agents.

nodes.speaker: Delbert Cherry
nodes.text: Check out Botan Noss, Reena Coda, Sanya Predex and if nothing works, try Finlay Basin.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Check out Botan Noss, Reena Coda, Sanya Predex and if nothing works, try Finlay Basin.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I wanted to know more about O.R.S.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I wanted to know more about O.R.S.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I wanted to know more about O.R.S.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I wanted to know more about O.R.S.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Maybe I want to get to know you better.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Maybe I want to get to know you better.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Maybe I want to get to know you better.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Maybe I want to get to know you better.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: How many members are there at the moment?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: How many members are there at the moment?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: How many members are there at the moment?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: How many members are there at the moment?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I’m not sure that’s how that works…

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I’m not sure that’s how that works…
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I’m not sure that’s how that works…
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I’m not sure that’s how that works…

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Rig. You steel-shanked wave defier, carry us on your back to freedom with fire!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Rig. You steel-shanked wave defier, carry us on your back to freedom with fire!
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Rig. You steel-shanked wave defier, carry us on your back to freedom with fire!
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Rig. You steel-shanked wave defier, carry us on your back to freedom with fire!

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I don't have time for this.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I don't have time for this.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I don't have time for this.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I don't have time for this.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Right. Well, I guess I'll go look for some new members.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Right. Well, I guess I'll go look for some new members.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Right. Well, I guess I'll go look for some new members.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Right. Well, I guess I'll go look for some new members.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: On second thoughts, maybe this isn't for me.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: On second thoughts, maybe this isn't for me.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: On second thoughts, maybe this isn't for me.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: On second thoughts, maybe this isn't for me.
